name: Yellow clam and white clam
summary: Ngao vàng and ngao trắng, yellow clam and white clam, are two more clam lines on the harbor boards, and neither carries the Phù Long label.
howToEat: Order them by weight; one board also sells ngao vàng by the piece. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
